curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Scruffy, crayon-on-rough-paper charm. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its place when set big and brief, its low-slung lowercase wobbling lightly, while Tsukimi Rounded keeps parenthesis-round forms that tire fast over long paragraphs.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose, leaning handwriting meets bookish type. Kapakana is best when its closed, nearly merging letter pairs get a few lines to flow, while Spectral SC, a serif with sturdy hairlines and wide mouths, does its work in steady text.
